final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_reference, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_filled) AS overall_avg FROM order_avgs), kept AS (SELECT order_reference, avg_filled, overall_avg FROM order_avgs CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_filled > overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_filled) AS kept_mean FROM kept) SELECT k.order_reference, k.avg_filled, k.avg_filled - k.overall_avg, k.avg_filled - a.kept_mean FROM kept AS k JOIN kept_avg AS a ON a.kept_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (k.avg_filled - a.kept_mean) IS NULL, k.avg_filled - a.kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
